title: A must get! Improvement on old app; no sound combining yet
content:
I’ve been using myNoise on my iPad for years, mostly via the older app, some via the website. myNoise helps me greatly with insomnia, stress, and tinnitus, transports me from my limited surroundings, and brings me much happiness.

The new app has a much more attractive, intuitive, and efficient interface. And it still does not sell our data. Hurray! Thank you! 🙏

I rave about myNoise every chance I get, and I always highlight 2 things: the huge library of incredibly skillful, beautiful, and varied recordings; and the ability to mix sounds into new soundscapes. The new app includes the complete selection of recordings, but I am eagerly awaiting the track combining feature. I need a purring kitty beside my roaring fireplace, after all!

I have a feature request. Please give us a way to export even just a simple text list of our downloaded and favorited soundscapes, so that if we lose that information due to getting a new device, we can recreate them. I have grieved losing all of them when I got a new iPad. I guess I could take screenshots. I should probably do that as a precaution. But a feature to make this easier would be welcomed! (Update: I just got word that the team will be looking into something to address this!)

I recommend to all myNoise users to read the app and website information thoroughly, and explore what you can do. There are lots of details that are not immediately obvious.

Kudos to developer Stéphane and his helpers. What an amazing labor of love, that truly makes so many lives better.

title: Passion Project - Support It Now
content:
I’ve been using this app and website for probably a decade at least. I share it with everyone and tell them to support it. Really happy with the newest version of the app.

Sometimes you come across apps where you can tell someone made it to genuinely help others and as a passion project. There is no data collection. You are not required to pay a subscription. It’s $20 for optional “lifetime support.” It’s even worded like that. If that sounds like a steep donation consider this:

1 There are so many sound scapes. At least 50 but I bet there’s more. Almost  anything you can think of: rain to dark creepy whispers to sitting in a coffee shop to walking in a forest. 

2 The soundscapes can be actual  recordings of real noises or generated or both.

3 The different tones are separated, and completely adjustable. Example: it’s the jungle, but you can turn down that one bug noise and it becomes YOUR perfect jungle. 

4 There are 10 fully adjustable sliders for EVERY sound scape.

5 The way it works never sounds like a loop and it’s not like some set amount of time where it ends and jumps to another one. It just keeps the noise going indefinitely with all the different tones that you chose. There are features surrounding this like timers and alarms like you’d expect but I don’t personally use them. 

6 Each sound scape has multiple creative presets for you to try. Even animating the sliders over time. It’s incredibly soothing waking up to the rain tones slowly adjusting as you are falling back asleep. 

7 It’s difficult to describe the perfect personalized sound massage until you experience it.

8 The newest version of the app has the greatest feature yet: you can download your personalized or some preset soundscape for offline listening… That’s right you don’t even need an internet connection anymore to use it. And it won’t cut out if your internet drops out. Absolutely incredible.

9 I know it has helped many folks. Diagnosed and not. 

10 Personally, it’s so high quality and useful I’ve donated to this app multiple times on top of the lifetime support because it is absolutely deserved.

In summary: it’s very high quality and clearly made with passion and kindness with no stipulations. 

To the creator, Dr. Ir. Stéphane Pigeon,
Thank you

title: Some soundscapes randomly stop working
content: I had a soundscape configured that I’ve been using for months to sleep. The app has worked great for months, I just turn on my Bluetooth speaker, start the app on my iPad, select my soundscape. About two nights ago, I did that, but the soundscape didn’t load and didn’t play. I switched to my iPhone and the app worked for one night and then last night it also stopped. There’s nothing that irritates me more than an app that just stops working randomly when I haven’t changed anything. Especially an app that is marketed as the ultimate white noise to help with sleep. Well, I did depend on it for sleep and it let me down.

content:
This new version of the myNoise app looks nicer and has a more intuitive UI. But I do miss the hearing calibration and noise blocker calibrations from the old app; not having hearing calibration means one can’t experience certain generators as intended, most notably Grey Noise. I am hoping that gets added to this app one day.

But more concerningly this app is somewhat unstable, sometimes it just crashes, or animation mode suddenly stops moving. But worst of all the app just sometimes fails to start - gets stuck at the splash screen forever. 

I can make do with the basic feature set, I just wish this app ran in a stable manner, please.

title: Hands down the best
content: Why 4 stars, then? Because unlike the previous app, there is no multi-gen. The sounds available are 5 stars. You won’t find any better. I love the presets in this app (not available in the older app). And although I like to use Airplay to stream to my HomePod, it’s glitchy on my iPhone and doesn’t work from my iPad. Fix these things, and it will be 5-stars all around!

title: Something For Everyone
content: I first tried the older version of this app and fell in love. This newer version seems to have an even greater variety of sounds. Everything from nature, to synth, to binaurals! I’m still exploring all the sounds and ways to listen to them. The only reason I deducted one star is that I miss the option to mix the soundscapes with each other. Although, I love the diverse soundscapes and options within them, I miss blending my own. But to be clear, that’s a minor thing! The sounds are clear, creative, and so diverse, I guarantee you’ll find something you love!  It’s like every sound/soundscape/ambience app combined but with better sound quality and an unbeatable price! If you are going to have one app that plays sounds (for any purpose or mood) I would 100% get this one. You won’t ever need another.

title: best white noise app i’ve found
content: someone recommended this app through reddit so i gave it a try. it genuinely helps block out noise without having to turn up the volume super high. it’s significantly helped me with sleeping and anxiety.

title: So much breadth and depth
content: This app brings a lot of sonic therapy to my life. I love being able to select many different sonic landscapes and have them provide a soundtrack to whatever I’m doing at the moment. Other times I’ll focus on the app generators, and it’s like a sonic journey.

title: Love.
content: This.

title: only noise generator i’ve ever used
content: this is my absolute favorite app for noise, and i’ve been using it since 2015. i still have the legacy app, but i’ve got this one downloaded for whenever that stops working. i use it to sleep but i also use it to study and write. i love how many different sounds there are, and it’s so clear that this comes from such a passion and love for sound. i also love how much i can play around with all the sliders to create unique experiences. all that is great, but also having it ad-free? no forced subscription? truly i thank you for this gift ❤️

title: Amazing noise app
content:
As a user of the legacy myNoise app, I wanted to share the app with one of my friends. I then found that the myNoise app had been completely re-designed and re-coded. Having used the old app built by Florian for several years, it’s a no-brainer to unlock the full access in the new version of the app. With this new app, I still have access to all the old generators that I loved, and will have access to everything new that comes out.

While there is a difference in the animations and I miss the multis, the new app is still a worthwhile upgrade - especially to ensure compatibility with future devices. 

P.S. The friend that I had download the new version of the myNoise app loves the fan sound. She says it’s the first noise app that has a realistic fan sound that she, an ADHD southerner, can use while traveling. With the right fiddling, it sounds just like a box fan :)

title: This is the best
content: I have tried many different sound players but this is the only one to give true white noise,natural sounds and background playing.

title: REALLY GOOD. better than brain.fm.
content: i’m so surprised this isn’t more popular??? really really useful app with lots of helpful options and variety that mixes up the droning ambience you can find everywhere. really high quality app.

title: Crashes after awhile
content: The sounds are great. Customization is great. App crashes if used long term.

title: This is the one!
content: MyNoise is something special. The sounds are high quality and customizable to create the perfect backdrop for sleeping, working, meditation, art, writing, reading, and etc. The multiple layers add richness and depth so that I feel transported into the sound environment. They are wonderful to use as background, but also really enjoyable to focus on directly as well! There are so many details to notice in each soundscape. Thank you!

title: The BEST
content: I’ve used this website daily for a while now. So glad they’ve made an app for it. It has so much more than just white noise. If you’re reading this review, give this app a chance and make a purchase to get the full library. You will not regret it.

title: myNoise diehard
content: I’ve been enjoying (and contributing to) myNoise on desktop and the old app for many years. The creators of myNoise are passionate about the project and go to great lengths to gather new and interesting soundscapes from all around the world. They have a fair monetization strategy and deserve your support.

title: Fantastic app
content:
I love the myNoise app, I have used it for years whether to help me fall back asleep at night, or as background sound in the office to help me focus. I have recommended it to everybody in search of some relaxation or better sleep. 
Now I was saddened to hear that a code developer left, we can’t update the old one, where I had unlimited locked; and we have to switch from the old app to the new app … so I don’t know if there will be an account transfer. But, anyway. This is the best background noise app I have found. Very high quality. Customizable sound scapes.

title: all the things you left in your version but didn't include in ours
content:
layering go? whitenoise atop binaural, this is a drug in its own right. prior versions allowed at least four layers, 

 and custom slider movement behavior? (zen, subtle, moderate, allegro, wobbler; all had distinct and specific uses, taught me to meditate, anyone deserves access to this)

variable fadeout duration for the timer was also loved, five minute fadeout as a gentle indicator of when, by simply noticing the sound's departure

we are not so stupid as to pay for returning features from legacy versions

        these made the app useful ♡, 

at the very least mixing binaural and whitenoise returning, useful for all sort

  sculpting for utility ❍☯︎•

title: Simply the best
content: So glad to see the best collection around getting an app to properly showcase it. After trying other apps that had a play together option but a poor sound quality/quantity, finding this new app with the same functionality but so much more quality was just what I wanted.

title: Incredible soundscapes!
content: I’ve long appreciated the website and I’m so excited for this app!  Thank you so much for all the time and effort you’ve devoted to this amazing collection - my tinnitus-plagued ears truly appreciate it!

title: A treat for the ears
content: I came from the desktop website which I already love and wow, this app! Oh my gosh. It's simultaneously comforting to explore and fascinating to peruse and life affirming! But most of all, it is a treat for the ears. Love it. Thanks!

title: Best background sounds
content:
I have used the old app and the website for years. They have wonderful high-quality sounds that you can tune easily to your needs. The owner is very friendly and always adding new stuff.

This looks like a nice upgrade and I'm happy to see it *except* that it's missing multi-gens. I almost never listen to a single sound alone - all of my favorites are multis. So unfortunately I will have to stick with the old app, unless that feature is added.

content: Old app was better by far. They’ve cut or partitioned my favorite sounds!

title: MyNoise is the GOAT!
content: I’ve been a myNoise user for over a decade. This new mobile app is amazing. It’s the incredible website in the palm of my hand. Sound quality is excellent. Worth every penny!! Even the free version is solid.

title: Best sounds around
content: I’ve been a user of myNoise since it was only available as a website. Absolutely best soundscapes out there. The quality and breadth of sounds is truly amazing and the updates over the years continue to delight me. I also appreciate the one time purchase model.

title: I miss the old ios version
content: I was an avid user of this app before changing it. I love how I could combine my sounds and play in the background. I also purchased the full version prior and no longer have the same access. Idk why there was such a drastic change but now I need a new app for my brainwave entertainment.

title: Makes my life a little better
content: I’ve been a user, first of the website, then the old app and now the new app. MyNoise is one of the first things that goes on any phone or laptop of mine. It just makes everything better. I work with it in the background and when I fly, it’s playing on my headphones. I’ve recommended this to everyone I know. And Stephane seems like a truly good person which probably explains a lot about why this app is great. Thank you for making my everyday life just a little bit better.

title: I loved the original version of the ios app
content: This app and website has been helpful for me for years but since this newer version for ios came out I lost the premium that I had already purchased in the past because there's no login option in the app. Unfortunately I also haven't been able to combine different sound packs the way you could in the previous versions, for example mixing a chior of singing bowls with thunderstorms. If these are just bugs that are being worked out then I'm very excited to get back to being able to mix my sounds to meet my needs, if not I hope they change their minds about taking away those features. Still a very good app and website though.

title: the Only Sound App I Can Focus With
content:
I work from home and am easily distracted.  My mind races and I find it difficult to focus on work.

MyNoise has completely changed that for me and I could not be more thankful to them.  The sounds are high quality, the app is stylish and easy to navigate, and there’s continuous, uninterrupted playback with no ads.  With a pair of ANC headphones I can focus for hours and be productive!

Although all of the sounds are top notch, if you’re a space junky like me you will be amazed at the different sounds MyNoise offers.  War Speed is my current favorite but Saturn Rings are a close 2nd.

I genuinely feel like no matter what your preference in sound is, there’s something for everyone.

Also if you ever have to contact the team, you can expect a prompt and friendly response like I received after entering the wrong email when I signed up 😅

From the bottom of my heart, thank you to this team and the wonderful work you do!

title: Indispensable
content: The new app looks great! I’m only an occasional user of the website and old app, but when I need it, I NEED it. Happy patron for years now and I don’t know where I’d be without myNoise!

title: Diamond in the rough
content:
So happy to see the app has been refreshed as I use it every night to go to sleep and all throughout the day when tinnitus is at its worst. 

The app has some polish items to take care of, but I trust Rémy will be diligent and address each over time. It's hard building an app with a small team and limited resources.

After all: no subscription fee here... just a one-time purchase, which is one of many reasons I give it 5 stars.

Been a myNoise supporter for many years now--some of the sounds were even recorded by me. Looking forward to a lifetime of supporting these fine folks in Belgium. Thank you Stéphane and Rémy (and developer!) for all your hard work.

title: New app, new subscription
content:

myNoise is finally reaching platform degradation stage, and it breaks my heart

title: Awesome app by an awesome team
